description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: single sofa along the upper wall facing into the room toward the dining area. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families; households needing multiple bedrooms; those requiring a home office or dedicated workspace; roommates needing separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: those requiring a home office or dedicated workspace
